data.body: 2026-09-26 verification of the build-hygiene change (same day): a 150 s slice of the real `cargo build --manifest-path desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin aworkit-desktop -v` showed 384 rustc invocations with -Cdebuginfo=1 (or absent for build deps, which also get -Cstrip=debuginfo) and ZERO -Cincremental flags, no profile errors; target/debug/incremental was recreated but stays EMPTY (0 files), confirming no incremental sessions. A control crate with no profile tables on the same toolchain emitted -Cdebuginfo=2 and -Cincremental=<path>, so the defaults were the cause. The slice was stopped deliberately and left ~2.6 GB of resumable cache (src-tauri/target 13.45 GB); a full build was not run to completion. Not eliminated: Cargo has no GC for stale hashed units in deps/build (only smaller now), ad-hoc --target-dir dirs are a process convention, and run-dir evidence retention is a user decision.
